messages:
deploy-bot: [AUTO] Canary stage 2 detected p95 latency breach in eu-west-1 (720ms > 500ms). Suggested action: AUTO-ROLLBACK to v2.9.0. Auto-rollback policy: global.
olivia: @deploy-bot saw it, thanks. mike/kate oncall — do we want a global auto rollback? we have an ongoing db migration in us-west.
kate: oncall here. spike lines up with the new kernel flag flip. prefer a targeted rollback for eu-west only, global revert could risk the migration. :eyes:
sam: we don't have a per-region auto-rollback override enabled for this pipeline; deploy-bot will perform a global revert unless a human intervenes. manual rollback recommended.
natalie: product note — a handful of paid dedicated customers in eu-west are seeing degraded responses. if we rollback, we should prepare a short comms update for them.
olivia: decision proposal: cancel the global auto-rollback, do a manual partial rollback in eu-west and pin v2.9.0 for that region. mike, can you run the manual rollback and raj set a release hold? i'll draft customer note.
mike: ack. starting manual rollback for eu-west. Command I'm running:
```
deployctl rollback --cluster eu-west-1 --service=inference --to=v2.9.0 --graceful --no-global
```
Pushing job now.
deploy-bot: Rollback job queued: jb-4829. Estimated duration ~6m. Note: Global release queue will be blocked while lock is set.
raj: setting global release hold: `releases:hold set --key canary-p95-euw --by raj --reason "canary p95 breach eu-west"` => done.
kate: monitoring p95 and error-rate in eu-west. if no improvement in 10m, we escalate to full global rollback. :triage: 
mike: rollback in progress — doing graceful pod replacement, draining connections. logs excerpt:
```
rolling to v2.9.0: pod/inference-3a -> terminating
new pod/inference-4b created with v2.9.0
healthcheck passed for 4/4 pods
```
mike: rollback completed for eu-west-1. All inference pods on v2.9.0, rolling restart finished. initial metrics: error rate down ~85% and p95 back to ~210ms.
natalie: customer note drafted and posted to #status-drafts. pinged support for review and add-on messages for dedicated customers.
olivia: good work. keep the release hold up for a 30m verification window. add to postmortem: ensure kernel-flag gated and add a per-region rollback policy.
kate: will watch for the next 30m and remove the hold if stable. removing the hold will be announced here. :white_check_mark:
